meta.title: AlphaESS ModBus RTU/TCP Protocol Register Map

Note1_battery_status.description: Battery status register (0x0103). Bits indicate charge/discharge state.

values.0: Charge and discharge relays are disconnected
values.3: Charge and discharge relays are closed

Note6_system_fault.description: System fault bitmask (0x0701–0702 / 0x08D4–08D5, 32-bit). Columns differ by EMS SN prefix AL vs AE.

bits_AE.6: Wrong direction of PV meter connection
bits_AE.7: SD not inserted or SD write error

Note8_grid_regulation.description: Grid regulation / safety standard code for register 0x1000.

Note9_safety_mode_enable.description: Safety mode enable bitmask for register 0x1002–1003.

bits.3: Power Factor Curve Mode — Fixed power factor mode
bits.4: Volt-WATT when Charging Mode — Characteristic power factor curve cos φ(P)
bits.5: Reactive power mode — Reactive power control mode

Cell ID of min cell voltage

Pack ID of min cell temperature

Cell ID of max cell temperature
Battery charge energy (cumulative)
registers.notes: Lifetime total. High word 0x0120, low 0x0121. No daily register on G3-T10.

registers.name: Battery discharge energy (cumulative)
registers.notes: Lifetime total. High word 0x0122, low 0x0123. No daily register on G3-T10.

registers.name: PV1 power (total PV power)
registers.notes: High word 0x041F, low 0x0420. Represents total PV power on G3-T10.

registers.name: Inverter total PV energy (cumulative)
registers.notes: Lifetime total. High word 0x043E, low 0x043F. No daily register on G3-T10.

registers.name: Inverter master software version
registers.notes: 5 registers, ASCII encoded, 2 chars per register. Regs 0x0640–0x0644.

registers.name: Inverter slave software version
registers.notes: 5 registers, ASCII encoded, 2 chars per register. Regs 0x0645–0x0649.

registers.name: Inverter serial number
registers.notes: 10 registers, ASCII encoded, 2 chars per register. Regs 0x064A–0x0653.

registers.name: UPS Reserve SOC
registers.notes: Minimum SOC kept for UPS/backup use (older block)

registers.name: Charge cut SOC
registers.notes: Minimum depth of discharge / stop charging below this (older block)

registers.name: Dispatch active power (HHE)
registers.notes: High word 0x0723, low 0x0724. Offset 32000; charge <32000, discharge >32000

registers.name: Set battery power
registers.notes: Used in Charge or Discharge mode

registers.name: Meter CT select
registers.notes: 0=Grid&PV CT; 1=Grid CT/PV Meter; 2=Grid Meter/PV CT; 3=Grid&PV Meter

registers.name: Time period control flag
registers.notes: 0=Disable, 1=Enable charge time period, 2=Enable discharge time period, 3=Enable both

registers.name: UPS Reserve SOC
registers.notes: Minimum SOC reserved for UPS/backup (primary block for G3-T10)

registers.name: Charge cut SOC
registers.notes: Minimum depth of discharge / stop charging below this (primary block for G3-T10)

registers.name: Dispatch start
registers.notes: 1=start, 0=stop. Write 0 first to clear before re-dispatching.

registers.name: Dispatch active power
registers.notes: High word 0x0881, low 0x0882. Offset 32000. Charge: value<32000. Discharge: value>32000. Example: charge 4000W → write 28000.

registers.name: Dispatch mode
registers.notes: See Note7. Use mode 2 (SoC control) for targeted charge/discharge.

registers.name: Dispatch SOC target
registers.notes: 0.4%/bit. Example: target 80% → write 200. Dispatch stops when SOC reached.

registers.name: Dispatch time
registers.notes: High word 0x0887, low 0x0888. Duration in seconds. Re-write repeatedly as heartbeat.
